characterizations.evidence: Every existing Goal, Plan, Agent and Scheduled Run, Workspace Run, Tool Invocation, and Kernel status is mapped through an exhaustive typed record.
Approval, guided input, context, usage, Chat message, and Trajectory observations remain adapter statuses and do not invent an owning-domain state machine.
Trajectory event names alone normalize to unknown; only a validated embedded Goal or Run status can normalize lifecycle.
Length-prefixed tuple identity prevents delimiter collisions and excludes list index or timestamp-only identity.
Contributor sets are authority-deduplicated, deterministically ordered, capped at 16 refs per page, and cursor-bound to scope, item, and set fingerprint.
Blocking items remain visible, explicit expansion preference is preserved, and restricted detail never becomes inline.
Required unknown data degrades coverage without a fabricated row, optional data yields a typed generic evidence row, and ignorable replay is counted once without a row.
Ephemeral or partial source cuts cannot claim complete coverage; incompatible cuts require degraded coverage.
Exact stale delivery is a no-op while scope, query, generation, projection, overlap, gap, conflict, and dishonest coverage request atomic reset with the prior object unchanged.
Settlements retain request, turn, attempt, sequence, fingerprint, outcome, and accepted assistant identity/content receipt so reset or accepted attempts cannot be resurrected or overwritten.

Begin, answer delta, exact duplicate, conflicting duplicate, gap, reset, supersede, late delta, retry, role-checked accept, durable receipt handoff, conflicting snapshot, and interleaved streams are characterized through one reducer.
Secret-shaped input is redacted before UTF-8 byte and line truncation; output contracts contain no raw reasoning, tool arguments, or unrestricted payload.

P104 proves required AgentLoop/provider pause can omit the Workspace Run event while ordinary pause can leave its snapshot running. CD02 does not connect to or misrepresent that source; CD03 owns causal settlement repair.

P104 records fire-and-forget Workspace Run writes that do not satisfy KM04's awaited-settlement claim. CD02 exposes durability and coverage instead of declaring these writes committed; CD03 owns convergence.
